task.description:
Write test specs and integration test source for SVC-01 through SVC-04. Each MUST requirement needs a runnable integration test against real PostgreSQL (BPM_TEST_DB_URL). Tests must use per-test UUIDs as fixtures. Write specs to tests/specs/SVC-01-04.md and test source files per the test developer guide. Set next_action: Route to TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR (Step 3b).

REWORK 1:
- [BLOCKER] TC-SVC-04-06 (svc04_admin_api_test.zig): fixture definition is inserted inside open harness transaction; pool connections cannot see uncommitted rows under READ COMMITTED. Fix: commit the definition insert outside the harness transaction using a separate direct connection with explicit cleanup (or use pool connection for fixture insert). Same pattern required for TC-SVC-04-08.
- [BLOCKER] TC-SVC-04-08 (svc04_admin_api_test.zig): same isolation bug for delete-in-use test. Apply same fix.
- [MAJOR] SVC-04 admin UI Services page has no E2E test. Add a Playwright E2E test to web/tests/e2e/ that verifies: platform-admin can access the Services page and sees the Register Service button; tenant-admin sees the page without the register button. Either create/extend the appropriate pipeline file with pl.step() entries, or write a standalone spec if no pipeline file exists for the admin UI yet.
acceptance_criteria: tests/specs/SVC-01-04.md written with one test per acceptance criterion
Integration test: service_catalog scope columns and constraint present after migration
Integration test: GET /api/v1/services filters by caller tenant
Integration test: cross-tenant scope rejection returns HTTP 422
Integration test: plugin registry dispatch filter (tenant-scoped plugin not invoked for wrong tenant)
Integration test: definition activation rejects cross-tenant service reference
Integration test: all SVC-04 admin API endpoints
All fixtures use per-test UUIDs, no shared state

result.summary: REWORK 1 complete: fixed TC-SVC-04-06 and TC-SVC-04-08 READ COMMITTED isolation bug (process_definitions fixture now inserted via committed pool connection); added E2E tests for SVC-04 admin Services page role-gate.
